evidence_quote: Enterprise Password Vault for secure and efficient workforce password management
notes: SPP (Safeguard for Privileged Passwords) is a hardened appliance-based vault; automated credential rotation supported; personal vaults also available. Covers passwords and SSH keys.

evidence_quote: control, monitor and record privileged sessions of administrators, remote vendors
notes: SPS (Safeguard for Privileged Sessions) acts as a transparent session proxy supporting RDP, SSH, Telnet, HTTPS, ICA, VNC. Credentials not exposed to end user during proxied sessions.

evidence_quote: all session activity is captured, indexed and stored for tamper-proof data trails
notes: Full session recording with OCR-indexed content; searchable audit trails; tamper-proof storage; session replay. Consistently cited as a market-leading capability.

evidence_quote: LDAP Privilege Elevation and Demotion support Just-In-Time (JIT) access
notes: JIT via SPP access request workflows (time-bound credential checkout) plus LDAP privilege elevation/demotion in 8.0 LTS. Full ZSP also requires Active Roles for AD group membership automation — note that component is ADD-ON/separate product.

evidence_quote: Discovery: Automatically find privileged accounts on your network; supports host, directory and network discovery
notes: Native discovery across host, directory, and network targets. Covers both privileged and local-admin accounts. Feeds accounts directly into SPP vault.

evidence_quote: third-party application to retrieve a credential from the Safeguard for Privileged Passwords vault
notes: Native A2A service: apps retrieve credentials via certificate + API key without user workflow; replaces hard-coded passwords in scripts/automation. IP restrictions supported.

evidence_quote: configuring authentication whitelists and blacklists to selectively require multi-factor authentication
notes: SPS integrates natively with Duo, Okta, RSA, inWebo, Starling 2FA, and others for MFA at privileged session initiation. SPP access request workflows also enforce MFA via One Identity Starling.

evidence_quote: Workflow Engine: Create your own workflows with time restrictions, multiple approvers, emergency access
notes: Emergency access policy configured in SPP; break-glass workflows bypass normal approvers, require justification, and generate audited alerts. MFA whitelists in SPS allow bypassing MFA for pre-designated break-glass accounts.

evidence_quote: Remove local admin rights and give users with elevated execution privileges
notes: Safeguard Privilege Manager for Windows is a separate licensed product for EPM on Windows; policy-based elevation, application control, digital certificate verification. Unix/Linux/macOS coverage handled via Safeguard for Sudo and Authentication Services — additional add-ons, not Safeguard core.

evidence_quote: providing a centralized platform with a 360 degree view of all user accounts and activities
notes: Entitlement right-sizing requires One Identity Manager (IGA) + Safeguard integration via Privileged Access Governance (PAG) module. Standalone Safeguard provides access request policy-based controls but lacks unused-entitlement analytics without OIM. [INDUSTRY-CONSENSUS: most PAM vendors rely on IGA integration for full right-sizing]

evidence_quote: Cloud-native access solution that connects remote users to privileged resources securely - without VPN
notes: Safeguard Remote Access (SRA) is a cloud-native SaaS add-on delivering agentless, browser-based vendor access (RDP/SSH) backed by SPS session recording. SPS alone also supports third-party/vendor session isolation and recording natively.

evidence_quote: CIEM at the intersection of IGA and PAM
notes: CIEM delivered via One Identity Manager (Identity Manager + Safeguard combined); not a standalone Safeguard module. Provides cloud-platform entitlement governance visibility and privileged access for cloud objects. Requires OIM license.

evidence_quote: Safeguard secret distribution service for pushing secrets to target DevOps environments
notes: Safeguard Secrets Broker for DevOps (open-source add-on) pushes rotated secrets to HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Kubernetes Secrets, Jenkins, GitHub. Architecture eliminates bootstrap secrets via push model. No native SPIFFE/OIDC workload attestation documented — broker still relies on vault credentials for app access. Gap vs. true secretless attestation.

evidence_quote: PAM access attestation allows attestation of what PAM users are entitled to do in the PAM appliance
notes: Privileged account certification and recertification is delivered through One Identity Manager (IGA) v9+ via the Privileged Account Governance module — a separate product licensed and deployed independently from Safeguard. Scheduled and on-demand recertification campaigns supported.

evidence_quote: detects deviations by using 13 different machine-learning algorithms
notes: SPA (Safeguard for Privileged Analytics) is a dedicated analytics module; ingests SPS session data; creates individual user behavioral baselines; ranks anomalies by risk; integrates automated session termination. Sold as part of Safeguard suite.

evidence_quote: screen content analysis... theft and misuse of privileged identities
notes: SPA detects credential theft via keystroke dynamics, mouse behavioral biometrics, session screen content analysis, and command analytics. Flags anomalies vs. per-user baseline. Automated session kill on high-risk events.

evidence_quote: join 3 or 5 SPP appliances into a single cluster; hot-spare pair replicates all information
notes: SPP supports 3- or 5-node clusters with full replication and automatic failover. SPS supports hot-spare HA pairs. Partial cluster upgrades without downtime in 8.0 LTS. On-prem appliance model; Safeguard On Demand (SaaS) option also available for cloud-native resilience.
